mentions.name: Gobaith
mentions.description: A mental health tracking app the author has used in various forms for around five years and rewritten multiple times, now accompanied by surrounding tooling to help others apply its mental model for personal life prioritization and energy management.
mentions.problem: Mental health impacts available energy, requiring careful prioritization of time and energy on things that matter.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tools to help my mental health tracking[0], and sharing with others how I manage my limited amount of energy[1]. They're kind of related, since mental health impacts my energy, so I've needed to prioritize and really make sure I'm spending my time and energy on things that matter.
